text: One day, the night sky will be completely empty.
A thousand years. The way you talk sounds as ancient as Old English.
Ten thousand. Vega is the new North Star.
A hundred thousand. Betelgeuse has exploded. Orion loses a shoulder.
A million. A passing star knocks comets loose.
Ten million. Africa splits, and a new ocean opens.
A hundred million. Mars has rings, and Saturn's are gone. Fashion is cyclical.
A billion years. The Sun gets hotter, and boils our oceans away. But that's not the strange part.
Five billion. The Sun swells into a red giant. Andromeda might crash into us. Scientists call it a coin flip.
Ten billion. The Sun is a fading white dwarf.
And a hundred billion years from now, space has stretched so far that every other galaxy has vanished from view. Anyone looking up would think their galaxy is the entire universe.
So look up tonight. You're seeing the limited edition.
